message.text:
Redesign the existing Room AC project in a genuinely DIFFERENT direction. The user rejected the sober ink/jade cards and asks for something closer to native Android with playful colors and a cheerful mood. UPDATE the three existing screens into: a LIGHT hero controller, matching expressive DARK controller, and a board with 2x2 and4x2 Android home-screen widgets. Keep exactly three screens in this run. This is a design proposal for a lightweight native Java Views/RemoteViews app, not React Native, Compose, WebView or a dashboard.

STYLE DIRECTION: playful, friendly and distinctly Android. Ground the design in Material You / Material3 Expressive: lilac and vivid violet as the main tonal family, buttery yellow for warm emphasis and small coral accents for delight, on soft warm off-white. Use real, readable contrast and restrained semantic colors. The dark theme should have deep plum and playful lavender/yellow tonal accents, not plain black and teal. Android system sans typography, very large friendly target numerals with clear degree unit, legible medium-weight labels, bold rounded pills, pill-shaped segment controls and a small local-vector cooling/spark motif. No photographs, gradients, glass, external imagery, invented avatar or web-dashboard chrome. Native Android status bar, top app bar, familiar switch/chip/button affordances and gesture-bar area. Use one generous expressive temperature surface as the focal point rather than a stack of outlined rectangular cards. Put personality into shapes, tonal color blocks and icon containers. Keep the main screen compact and reachable, with much less explanatory copy than the original. The whole composition must be newly thought out, not a recoloring of the previous layout.

HIERARCHY: top app bar with Room AC and synthetic Bedroom selector. Compact last-read Updated10:24 and Refresh. Friendly large target23°C and smaller Room24.18°C, with a practical minus/plus stepper and explicit Set action when drafted. Power and AC display should BOTH be immediately accessible as separate clear labeled native controls in a compact hierarchy. Four expressive segmented mode choices Auto/Cool/Dry/Fan. FanAuto entry, and compact Morecontrols entry for Eco/Powerful/Capacity. Readings is a secondary destination/sheet, not a dense data dashboard. One screen should show a tasteful selected-but-unapplied mode specimen with explicit Apply, while preserving the reported currentCool state and disabling dependenttemperature/fan untilApply. Keep the matching darkscreen composition equivalent. Main360–412dp width, min48dp touchareas, scroll safely if needed; avoid giant cards that push displaycontrolbelowfold. Do not put integration/debug/explanatory text into everydayproductcopy.

REAL CAPABILITIES: only Auto, Cool, Dry, Fan (no Heat). Target16–30°C in1°C steps. FanAuto/Quiet/Low/Medium/High. Poweron required for mode/temp/fan. Fan-only hides temperature controls. Dry disables manualfan and letsACmanageit, no forcedLowclaim. Cleaningdisablestemp/fan. Mode draft must be explicitly applied before dependentsettings. Display on/off is independent of ACpower and is already shipped in the mainapp. Eco is Coolonly and enabling sets26°C, shown in its confirmation sheet, not a misleading instanttogglestate. Powerful is Coolonly and cannot run duringcleaning, enablingdisablesfixedcapacity; capacitydisablesPowerful. CapacityoptionsNormal0,40,50,60,70,80,90,100,110% advertisedonly. No added scheduling, timers, swing, cleaningcontrol, automation or MQTT as ifimplemented. No fakehumidity, RPM or livecontinuousmetrics.

READINGS AND STATES: roomtemperature canbefractional, fansetting isnotRPM, errorswarnings/online/RSSI/rawfields available. DailyenergykWh loadedondemand; todaypartial. Readingssavedonmanualrefresh/commandreadback/widgetrefresh, no automaticlogger, no fabricatedcontinuouschart. CSVexports readings/energy separate. Missingstate displaysunknown/lastknown, notzero. APIacceptedisnotphysicalsuccess; pending/failed/unconfirmedstates needhonestnativefeedback. Use syntheticBedroom/23°C/24.18°C sampledataonly, nodeviceIDs/accounts. Appconfirmationupdatesonlyafterreadback.

WIDGET BOARD: show cheerful MaterialYou2x2 and4x2 launcherwidgetproposals, visuallyrelatedtomainapp, not mimickingfullappcards.2x2:titleopensapp, read-onlytarget/mode/update, visiblecurrentpowerstate and an explicitOffaction+Refresh with48dptargets.4x2:title/target/roomtemp/mode/readtime, explicitPowerOff, proposedDisplaytoggle,Refresh. Displaycontrol inwidgetisproposed, notshipped; labelthisoutsidewidgetinboardannotations. No +/−widgetcommand because it needsdeliberatecommit. Keepannotationsoutsideactualwidgetfaces. ShowONE realisticstate, not pendinganderror simultaneously. Alternatepending/failed/unconfirmedstate rulesgoinspec. No promisefrequentautomaticrefresh. Renderwidgetdimensionlabelsaslauncher-targets, notexactdevicegeometry.

Deliver polished original visualdesigns in one pass. Use embeddedlocalvectoricons and systemfont; no remotefont/assetsneededforfuture nativeimplementation. Keep UItextconcise and human. Start fromthisnewdirectionfully and updateallthreeexistingcomponents.
